result.topic_en: Draft of introductory definitions for Riemann's treatment of linear differential equations: a continuous (single-valued) branch of a function in a neighbourhood, branches and branch values of many-valued functions, the geometric representation of complex quantities, functions of x+yi defined by a differential equation, their power-series representation, and their unique determination from values on a line.
